name: Michigan MHSAA Lower Peninsula Cross Country Finals
headline: Michigan: Dudek repeats and No. 4 Ann Arbor Pioneer wins Division 1
summary: No. 1 Natasza Dudek repeated as the Division 1 girls champion in 16:26.6, the second-fastest girls time in Finals history behind her own 16:09.5 from last year. Her Ann Arbor Pioneer teammates Keira Von Blon (16:49.8) and Sienna Klemmer (16:54.7) were second and third, and the No. 4 Pioneer girls won the team title with 87 points. Pioneer senior Kamari Ronfeldt also repeated in the boys race, running 14:45.9, the second-fastest time in Finals history behind Dathan Ritzenhein’s 14:10.4 from 2000.
